title: Rice Blast Disease (Pyricularia oryzae)
content:
Rice blast is caused by the fungus Pyricularia oryzae (Magnaporthe oryzae). It is one of the most destructive diseases of rice worldwide, capable of causing 30-100% yield loss under favorable conditions.

Symptoms: Leaf blast produces diamond-shaped lesions with gray centers and brown margins on leaves. Node blast causes black/brown discoloration at nodes, which may break. Neck blast affects the panicle neck, causing white/brown discoloration and empty grains.

Favorable conditions: High humidity (90%+), temperatures 25-28°C, extended leaf wetness (12+ hours), high nitrogen fertilizer application, and dense canopy.

Management: Use resistant varieties. Apply balanced fertilizer (avoid excess nitrogen). Maintain proper spacing. Chemical control: triazole or strobilurin fungicides at booting stage if disease pressure is high. Always follow label instructions for dosage.
content_hi:
धान का झुलसा रोग Pyricularia oryzae नामक फफूंद से होता है। यह दुनिया भर में धान की सबसे विनाशकारी बीमारियों में से एक है।

लक्षण: पत्तियों पर हीरे के आकार के भूरे किनारों वाले धब्बे। गांठों पर काला/भूरा रंग। बालियों की गर्दन पर सफेद/भूरा रंग और दाने खाली रह जाना।

अनुकूल परिस्थितियां: 90%+ नमी, 25-28°C तापमान, 12+ घंटे पत्तियों का गीला रहना, अधिक नाइट्रोजन।

प्रबंधन: प्रतिरोधी किस्में लगाएं। संतुलित उर्वरक का प्रयोग करें। उचित दूरी बनाए रखें।
summary: Rice blast is a devastating fungal disease causing diamond-shaped leaf lesions and panicle damage. Thrives in high humidity (90%+) at 25-28°C.
summary_hi: धान का झुलसा रोग एक विनाशकारी फफूंद जनित रोग है जो पत्तियों पर हीरे के आकार के धब्बे और बालियों को नुकसान पहुंचाता है।
actions: Monitor the field daily for diamond-shaped leaf lesions. Check the leaf collar and neck area.
Reduce nitrogen fertilizer application if leaves are dark green and lush — excess nitrogen favors blast.
Improve field drainage — standing water for >12 hours increases blast risk.
If blast is confirmed and at booting/heading stage, apply a recommended triazole fungicide following label instructions EXACTLY.
Remove and destroy severely infected plants to reduce spore load.
For the next season, plant a blast-resistant rice variety like IR64, Swarna Sub1, or DRR Dhan 44.
warnings: Do NOT apply fungicide during heavy rain or if rain is forecast within 24 hours.
Do NOT exceed the recommended fungicide dose — it will not improve control and may harm beneficial organisms.
Blast can be confused with brown spot. If lesions are oval (not diamond-shaped), consult brown spot guidance first.
